description: Check url slug. The "Check url slug" API allows check the blog slug validation which is needed before publishing any blog post. Please use blogs/check-slug.readonly. you can find the POST ID from the post edit url.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name: crm_checkUrlSlugExists
